description: Lokale productie-installaties per gemeente is a dataset listed in Fluvius open data portal, an open data portal of a distribution network operator, published or maintained by Fluvius (Flanders). In deze dataset zitten alle lokale productie-installaties elektriciteit die aangesloten zijn op het distributienet van Fluvius, per gemeente. Het totaal aantal en geïnstalleerd vermogen is weergegeven met vermelding van type van de installatie (wind, warmte-krachtkoppeling (wkk), zonne-energie, …). Coverage: Belgium (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Energietransitie: adoptie van nieuwe technologieën. Its keywords are Decentrale productie, Zonnepanelen, Zonne-energie, Windenergie, Warmtekrachtkoppeling, Brandstofcel. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open data license - FLUVIUS (https://opendata.fluvius.be/p/licentieopendatafluvius). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fluvius-open-data-portal.
